question: Given \(a>b\) and \((m-2)a<(m-2)b\), the range of \(m\) is
solution: When \(a>b\) becomes \((m-2)a<(m-2)b\), the inequality sign reverses, indicating multiplication by a negative number. Thus, \(m-2<0\), so \(m<2\).
